name: Weighted Plank
steps: Set your forearms on the floor with elbows beneath shoulders, then extend your legs into a plank.
Brace your abdomen and have a partner place the plate flat across your upper back, clear of your neck.
Press actively through your forearms to keep your shoulder blades stable and prevent your hips from sagging under the extra load.
Hold while breathing steadily, then have the partner remove the plate before you lower your knees.
tips: Place the plate across your upper back and shoulder blades rather than directly over your lower spine.
End the hold as soon as your lower back begins to arch downward.
